title: Reconstruction from enough shares
statement: Let $F$ be a field in which equality is decidable, let $d\in\mathbb N$, and let $x\in F$ and $f$ be a function from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$. If $f$ shares $x$ using a polynomial of degree at most $d$, then for every finite set $A$ of nonzero field elements with $d+1\le |A|$, the reconstruction sum using the Lagrange coefficients for $A$ and the shares $f(i)$ equals $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a field with decidable equality
A share function $f$ on nonzero elements of $F$
A finite set $A$ of nonzero field elements with $d+1\le |A|$
